title: Onboard Helion-13b v1.0 — perf profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard Helion-13b v1.0 into the model registry. This PR adds model metadata (supported tokenization, context-window, recommended quantization profiles), generated performance profiles (throughput/latency for common sequence-length buckets and batch sizes), and wires up automated changelog/release-note generation for registry-onboard events. Motivation: Helion is a high-priority open model requested by several customers for lower-cost mid-sized instruction-following workloads; adding perf profiles and metadata enables the serving runtime and console to recommend optimal configurations and show transparent perf/cost tradeoffs. This PR also improves the onboarding automation so that new model entries trigger a changelog snippet in the release notes pipeline and uploads perf artifacts to the artifact store for UI consumption.

release_notes:
- Onboarded Helion-13b v1.0: added model metadata (context window=2048, tokenizer=BPE-50k), recommended quantization: int8/4bit for cost-sensitive workloads.
- Added performance profiles for common workloads (seq=128/512/2048) — used by the console to provide cost/latency estimates.
- Automation: model onboarding now emits changelog snippets and uploads perf artifacts to perf-bucket, enabling faster release note generation.
